title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E09 — And the City of Light
An investigation into a missing person uncovers what appears to be an alien invasion in a small town.

title: The Librarians
description:
S01 E10 — And the Loom of Fate
When Dulaque changes the course of fate, Baird begins moving through alternate timelines that reveal the changing destinies of the librarians.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E01 — The Weekend in Paris Job
On the run from a busted heist in Paris, the team finds themselves taking shelter among oligarchs auctioning off their home nations' precious resources; they have to create a new con to take down the group's ringleader and save an activist.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S03 E02 — The Digital Frankenstein Job
The team conducts a sting to snare a corrupt judge by using the perfect undercover briber, a completely virtual tech visionary generated by A.I.; they watch as their "Digital Frankenstein" quickly spins out of control.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E07 — And the Con-Con
Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E08 — And the Hangover From Hell
After a bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E05 — Deus Ex-Wife Machina
Alex's ex-wife shows up with her new fiancé asking Alex to sign their divorce papers; however, when the fiancé is mistaken for Alex and kidnapped by an old enemy, Alex finds himself racing to rescue the man.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E06 — Ghost Month
During the traditional Ghost Month in the Philippines, Alex seems to be visited by the spirit of a dead man, wrongly accused of a crime, who seeks justice from the afterlife.

The crew arrives somewhere that seems too good to be true, and it just might be.

title: Almost Paradise
description:

Before the grand opening of Mactan's resort casino owned and operated by the Villegas family, Ann Villegas recruits Alex to test the casino's security system.

title: Almost Paradise
description:

Kai and Alex go undercover as a New Age-y couple at a self-help retreat in order to extract a naïve young woman from the clutches of a dangerous cult.

description: Jack and Jill see a fortune-teller who predicts they will meet the love of their lives before the end of the year, which is five days away. The countdown begins as they both go on a series of horrible and hilarious dates, each worse than the next.

While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

description:
S01 E10 — And Going Medieval
When Vikram attempts to return to 1847, via a homemade time machine, he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and Elaine.

description:

Our team runs the "Christmas Carol" con on a wannabe cryonics mogul who coerces dying patients into exploitative contracts bankrupting the loved ones they leave behind.

description:
S01 E12 — And the Unfinished Business
General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal; the team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

description:
S03 E05 — The Grand Complication Job

description:
